description: This file defines the 'HeaderDefinition' interface within the OrangeHRM project, specifically under the namespace for report headers. It declares methods for normalizing the header to an array and retrieving metadata as a ParameterBag.

classes.name: HeaderDefinition
classes.description: Interface for defining report header components, requiring normalization and metadata retrieval methods.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts the header definition into an associative array.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves associated metadata as a ParameterBag object, or null if none exist.
